ingredients_summary: Vegetable oil without a named plant source
Dried skimmed milk listed as an ingredient
Tartaric acid listed among raising agents
Flour blend declared at 55%, with fortification details
Palm identified as the vegetable-oil source
No milk ingredient listed; a may-contain-milk notice remains
Ammonium bicarbonate listed among raising agents

changes.label: Declared milk ingredient
changes.after: No milk ingredient listed; may-contain notice retained
changes.note: This establishes a declaration difference, not the date or reason a formulation changed.

changes.label: Vegetable-oil description
changes.note: The earlier record does not identify its oil source. This does not prove that palm oil was newly introduced or replaced butter.

changes.label: Declared flour percentage
changes.note: The later declaration also lists fortification details; compare the declarations rather than inferring an exact manufacturing adjustment.

changes.label: Raising-agent declaration
changes.after: Ammonium bicarbonate listed; tartaric acid not listed
changes.note: Sodium bicarbonate and malic acid appear in both documents.

limitations: The 2008 date is a recorded purchase; the 2022 date is a document update. Neither is a reformulation date.
The documents concern different pack sizes in the same named product family; no historical barcode chain or exact recipe-transition event is established.
Some differences may reflect more detailed labelling. No oil substitution, cost saving, quality decline or manufacturer motive is established.
Do not merge these ingredient-observation dates with the separate 2018/2019 size-and-price comparison.

ingredients_summary: Coating share declared at 28% of the biscuit
Cocoa butter separately listed in the coating
Vegetable fat already listed, with plant source unspecified
Coating share declared at 29% of the biscuit
Palm and shea specifically named in the coating
Cocoa butter not separately listed; cocoa mass remains declared

changes.label: Coating description
changes.note: The declarations use different descriptions. No legal-classification claim is made.

changes.label: Declared coating share
changes.note: These are whole-product coating fractions, not cocoa percentages. They do not measure a cocoa-content decrease.

changes.label: Separately declared cocoa butter
changes.note: This does not establish that the product contains no cocoa butter; cocoa mass remains listed.

changes.label: Vegetable-fat description
changes.before: Vegetable fat listed without a named plant source
changes.note: Vegetable fat was already present in the older declaration; no exact substitution amounts or date are established.

limitations: The 2008 date is a recorded sample purchase; the 2026 date is page access. The reformulation date is unknown and multiple changes may lie between them.
An 18-pack sample and a current product page do not establish a pack-replacement chain; no shrinkflation or price calculation is attached.
The documents do not quantify cocoa removed, ingredient-cost savings, product quality or manufacturer motive.
Original manufacturer HTML was not downloaded: direct HTTP returned 403. The saved source is an honest access note and paraphrased fact extract.
